content:
**Roast Megasloth** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of Megasloth Meat that has been roasted, improving its nutritional qualities.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Megasloth Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Megasloth Meat | | Roast Megasloth (1) | 

It can be crafted at any Cooking Station. The recipe is automatically learned when Megasloth Meat is picked up for the first time.
